newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian govt to mull regional Eurobond issues Fri.
newsitem.headline: Russian govt to mull regional Eurobond issues Fri.

text.p: Russian First Deputy Prime Minister Vladimir Potanin will meet with officials on Friday to discuss regional Eurobond issues and depositary activity, Potanin's spokeswoman said.
She told Reuters the officials would discuss a new 15 percent tax on government securities and standardising depositary activity.
Potanin will meet officials from the Finance Ministry, Central Bank and Federal Commission on Capital Markets.

Several Russian regions and cities, including Nizhny Novgorod, Moscow and St Petersburg, are considering issuing Eurobonds. But the issues have been delayed by a lack of clarity in Russian legislation, including tax problems.
Finance Minister Alexander Livshits said on Friday that regions must coordinate their issues with his ministry.
"If they try to avoid the Finance Ministry and do not use sovereign ratings they will get little but expensive money," he told a news conference.
